themes.theme: App won't open / login / slow / errors

findings.title: Ratings fell sharply in the v13 era
findings.body: From May to October, reviews from people on v13 were 52.6% negative (n=825), against 26.8% for people still on v12 in the same months (n=246). Before March, v12 reviews were about 18% negative. This is an association, not proof of cause: version is what the reviewer was running, and v12 holdouts are a self-selected group.

findings.title: App access and speed is the biggest complaint; unreachable support is next
findings.body: By automatic tags, 27% of 1 and 2 star reviews are about the app not opening, login failures, slowness or errors, and 14% mention unreachable support. In a hand-labelled sample of 59, the shares were 27% and 24%, so support is probably undercounted.

findings.title: Money stuck is the smaller share, but the highest-stakes one
findings.body: Delayed or failed transfers, refunds and ATM disputes together are at most about 10% of negative reviews. In the 59 hand-labelled reviews, 3 of the 6 transfer complaints also say support did not respond. The sample is very small.

findings.title: Public replies are fast, but mostly point to a private channel
findings.body: 77% of negative reviews get a developer reply, with a median delay of 1.7 days. 68% of replies use one template asking the user to contact Edenred by WhatsApp or phone. What happens after that is not visible from outside.

findings.title: A payday pattern shows up only in the v13 era
findings.body: In May to October, payday windows (28th to 3rd) were 51.6% negative (n=314) against 43.9% mid-month (n=670). Before May there is no meaningful gap (for example 30.3% vs 30.1% in March and April). One period out of three, so treat it as exploratory.

findings.title: Review volume fell about 90% while the mix turned negative
findings.body: English UAE reviews dropped from 875 in November to 85 in September. The cause is unknown. A change in how ratings are requested is one possibility, a real quality change is another. The listing's lifetime 4.3 comes from 182K ratings and hides this recent shift.

quotes: Paraphrased from public reviews: a user who sent money to Nepal by mistake says they were told to message on WhatsApp and by SMS, and heard nothing back.
Paraphrased from public reviews: several v13 users say the app opens only after repeated attempts, or shows a technical error with no next step.
Paraphrased from a public App Store review: a user says cash was not dispensed at an ATM but the amount was deducted, and the case was still described as ongoing after more than 100 days.
